description: Implementation of uplink request handler for PRACH and uplink slots, managing PRACH occasions, timing, and data flow scheduling in a radio communication system.

classes.name: uplink_request_handler_impl
classes.description: Handles uplink requests, PRACH occasions, and slot management in a radio network.

methods.name: get_prach_cplane_filter_index
methods.description: Determines the Open Fronthaul filter index based on PRACH preamble info and context.

methods.name: extract_ul_cp_timing
methods.description: Extracts UL timing parameters, setting others to zero.

methods.name: get_prach_start_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the start OFDM symbol index for PRACH preamble based on context.

methods.name: handle_prach_occasion
methods.description: Processes a PRACH occasion, including timing, frequency mapping, and scheduling.

methods.name: handle_new_uplink_slot
methods.description: Handles a new uplink slot, managing late requests and scheduling uplink data.
